The <b>Dead Bug's Purse</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It allows [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to retain half her [[Rosaries]] upon death, rounded to the nearest even number. The rest of the Rosaries will remain in her [[Cocoon]].

== Usefulness ==
The Dead Bug's Purse allows the [[Rosary Cannon]] to be reloaded between deaths.

== How to Acquire ==
The Dead Bug's Purse can be found on a corpse in the northeast portion of the [[Wormways]]. The tool is replaced by the {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Shell Satchel]] in {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]].
